items.name: Thrill of the Hunt
items.mechanic: End of turn: wolves on this Beastmaster hex gain 10 initiative. Whenever any wolf gets a kill, allies on its hex gain +2 damage for the battle.

items.name: Executioner
items.mechanic: Champions target the lowest-health enemy they are allowed to attack.

items.name: Anointed
items.mechanic: Whenever a Champion is healed or gains positive stats, it gains twice as much.

items.name: True Form
items.mechanic: Druid's Shapeshift can now trigger an additional time.
items.trigger: endOfTurn; charge every 5 turns; max 2 uses

items.name: Wild Growth
items.mechanic: End of turn: each Druid heals itself for 60.

items.name: Bramble Snare
items.mechanic: Each time a Druid shapeshifts, its melee attacks gain an additional battle-long -2 speed debuff on hit.

items.name: Thornhide
items.mechanic: After shapeshifting, attackers take 6 damage whenever they hit the Druid with a normal attack.

items.name: Wild Call
items.mechanic: Whenever a Druid shapeshifts, it summons 2 wolves.

items.name: Arc Conductor
items.mechanic: When an allied elemental dies, blast its hex for 8.

items.name: Living Circuit
items.mechanic: End of turn: if any allied elemental is in range, this Elementalist gains 15 initiative once and all allied elementals in range gain 15 initiative.

items.name: Mitosis
items.mechanic: Every 4 turns, each Elementalist summons 1 elemental. Each summoned elemental can repeat that summon once after 4 turns.

items.name: Brace
items.mechanic: Start of turn: if a Knight is engaged at full capacity, it gains +5 armor until next turn.

items.name: Retaliate
items.mechanic: Whenever a Knight is hit by a normal attack, it makes 1 normal attack back.

items.name: Challenge Accepted
items.mechanic: Enemies redirected by this unit deal 4 less damage while engaged with it.

items.name: Sentinel Runes
items.mechanic: The first time an enemy moves off a Knight's hex, summon 2 elementals on that unit's new hex. If unused, this also triggers when the Knight dies.

items.name: Rabble Rush
items.mechanic: Start of turn: Militia gain +1 initiative for each other Militia on their hex.
items.trigger: startOfTurn; scales per other friendly unit on hex

items.name: Dogpile
items.mechanic: When Militia attack an enemy engaged by at least 3 allies, they strike 1 extra time.

items.name: Scurry
items.mechanic: Militia do not count toward allied saturation limits.

items.name: Alternate Fuel
items.mechanic: Necromancers may spend 10 health instead of requiring or consuming a corpse for corpse-consuming abilities, as long as that would not kill them.

items.name: Early Riser
items.mechanic: Skeletons summoned by Necromancers spawn with +100 initiative.

items.name: Carrion Choir
items.mechanic: Whenever this Necromancer consumes a corpse, enemies adjacent to that corpse lose 1 armor and 1 damage for the battle.

items.name: Rising Tide
items.mechanic: Skeletons summoned by Necromancers heal allies on their own hex for 7 at the end of each turn.

items.name: Overflowing Grace
items.mechanic: When a Priest heal brings an ally to full HP, that ally gains 40 initiative.

items.name: Mercy Before Dawn
items.mechanic: The first time each battle each allied unit within this Priest's range would die, it survives at 1 HP.

items.name: Zeal
items.mechanic: Whenever a Priest heals a target, that same target also gains +1 speed and +1 damage for the battle.

items.name: Concussive Shots
items.mechanic: On attack: each Ranger sets its target initiative to 0.

items.name: Skirmisher's Step
items.mechanic: After attacking, Rangers move to the safest hex that still keeps an enemy in range.

items.name: Heartseeker
items.mechanic: Ranger attacks against unengaged targets deal double damage.

items.name: Scavenger's Hunger
items.mechanic: The first 3 times a Ranger kills a non-Fading enemy, consume the corpse and summon 1 wolf there.

items.name: War Drums
items.mechanic: Enhance 1 affects all allies on the chosen ally hex instead of one random ally.

items.name: Serve Once More
items.mechanic: Whenever a Shaman applies a beneficial effect, that target leaves no corpse on death and summons 1 skeleton on death.

items.name: Static Charge
items.mechanic: When a Shaman applies Enhance, affected allies gain 1 extra strike on their next normal attack.

items.name: Shield Drill
items.mechanic: Allies on a Soldier's hex take 1 less damage from ranged attacks and strikes.

items.name: Leyline Focus
items.mechanic: Start of turn: if no enemy is within 1 hex, the Wizard gains 25 initiative.

items.name: Spell Echo
items.mechanic: Each time this Wizard's Blast deals damage with Blast, repeat that Blast on an adjacent hex that hasn't been hit by any Blast in this chain.

items.name: Storm
items.mechanic: Every 4 turns, each Wizard makes 4 extra strikes against a random enemy within its range.

items.name: Lightning Rods
items.mechanic: Wizard Blasts deal +1 damage per elemental on the target hex, and Wizards summon 1 elemental at the start of battle.
